nodes.instruction: Navigate to the Meta Events Manager to get your Pixel credentials
Click the Settings tab to view your Pixel ID and Conversions API
Copy the Pixel ID — it will be saved to your Ouija clipboard
Copy the access token — it will not be shown again
Navigate to your Shopify admin to paste the credentials
Paste your Pixel ID from the clipboard into the Pixel ID field
nodes.verify_condition: The Pixel ID input field (aria-label Pixel ID) has a non-empty value. ONLY check this one field, ignore the access token field.

nodes.instruction: Paste your access token from the clipboard into the token field
nodes.verify_condition: The Access token input field (aria-label Access token) has a non-empty value. ONLY check this one field, ignore the Pixel ID field.

nodes.instruction: Click Save to connect your Meta Pixel
nodes.verify_condition: The page shows a success state: Meta Pixel connected or Connected checkmark visible

graph_template.welcome_message:
Let's connect your Meta Pixel to Shopify. First, head to the Meta Events Manager to grab your credentials:

https://ouijaboard.vercel.app/demo/meta-events-manager

Open that link, then press **Done** when you're there.
